title: VERDICT: dashboard-per-repo attempt APPROVED (hold-merge)
summary:
Adversarial code review of impl attempt orch/attempt/b1c48279-...-1 (daemon.js, routes/meta.js, routes/session.js, public/graph.html, test/workspaces-daemon.test.js). APPROVE — hold-merge (flat task, dispatcher merges; judge did NOT merge).

VERIFIED: (1) GET /workspaces unions workspaces.json registry + state.workspace + session + agent + graphStore.allStores() dirs (cross-platform /.graph strip via both path.sep+'.graph' and '/.graph'), dedupes via Set, returns {ok,current,workspaces:[{path,name,current}]}, NO buildGraph (pure path enumeration — cheap). setWorkspace persists workspaces.json as a best-effort union (read/append-if-absent/write, try-catch like WS_FILE). fs+path are module-level requires in meta.js; WORKSPACES_FILE+graphStore correctly added to ctx destructure and exported from daemon.js.

(2) DASHBOARD COMPLETENESS (highest risk) — CLEARED. Every per-repo fetch routes through dfetch(): /state (x3 incl resilient tick + no-store), /costflow (x3), /task/detail (x3), /guidance, /graph/delta, /search, AND the /guidance/resolve POST (x2). Correctly left raw/global: /workspaces (picker source), /cron/usage (x3), /harness/overhead (x2), /health (HEALTH_URL), /active-claim ping (result discarded), and /events EventSource (change-signal only — onmessage just calls tick() which itself uses dfetch('/state'), so no workspace leak). No per-repo endpoint left on raw fetch.

(3) RESOLVE-WORKSPACE detail — CORRECT. targetOverlay(b,u) = (b&&b.workspace) || u.searchParams.get('workspace') || state.workspace. /guidance/resolve POST calls targetOverlay(b,u); dashboard sends workspace as QUERY param (not body), so with no body.workspace it falls through to the query param. Per-repo resolve targets the right overlay. (Server-side /state, /costflow, /graph/delta, /search, /task/detail, /guidance ALL already honored ?workspace= pre-change — impl correctly only added the client threading + the comment.)

(4) SCOPE — clean. No auth/token redesign; /cron|/health not made per-re
